description: Session 54 (key-signature design §13.2): every fixture and gallery file, saved with each of session 53's key-signature styles (notehead-chords in the middle; accidentals in the middle and on every line set) in four keys, rendered by CNBCollection.render at crotchet through the stub DOM and exported by CNBLilypond.generate (its date line removed), hashed with session 53's code (commit 5656e8a), before the styles became one model. cnb/tests/cnb-key-signature-tests.js loads the same configs through CNBConfigIO.loadFromText, which converts the style, and holds every render and export to these hashes.
